title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1547: Kill invincibles, suppress myriad realms (1)

title.p: Chapter 1547: Kill invincibles, suppress myriad realms (1)

section.p: Silently taking a beating was not in line with Su Yu’s temperament. Rather than taking a beating, he much preferred attacking.
He soared even higher and roared, “Lord Grandstar, please assist me outside the city!”
A lot of people were focusing on the survivors, but some were still keeping an eye on the ancient city. That roar of Su Yu surprised many people.
Su Yu continued roaring, “I am here. What do you want? If you want to kill me, come at me!”
Grandstar flew out of the city and stopped beside Su Yu.
Su Yu continued, “Are you seeing this? Lord Grandstar is here. How can I be fake? Are you dumb?”

This was a display of anxiousness. That was the conclusion of the sneering Invincibles. He was growing anxious. The fake Su Yu was anxious. If this was the real Su Yu, what about the Su Yu in the mansion?

Su Yu roared, “If you doubt me, you can inspect me. Come! I’m right here! I am Su Yu! Are you not ashamed of taking your anger out on unrelated individuals? Do you insist in inspecting everyone? Are you not worried of offending the various races? I can see that those from the five elemental, fate, divine, iron devourer, hou, and spatial beast races are among the survivors as well. Do you intend to offend so many people?”
The Invincibles merely stared at him silently. Some even had toying expressions as they enjoyed his performance. He was looking very anxious. How could the real Su Yu be so anxious?
Grandstar said, “He is Su Yu. He has never entered the Luminous Domain Mansion.”
Wow. Even the guardian was getting anxious. With that, they became even more certain that the real Su Yu was among the survivors. As for the fake Su Yu…heh, he was nothing. Everyone ignored him.

With an exasperated expression, Su Yu flew forward and shouted, “Those from the holy cities are among the survivors as well! You are not allowed to inspect them! I will consider such an action a declaration of war!”
“War!”

Grandstar echoed Su Yu. At this point, he already understood what Su Yu was doing. Stabbing someone in the back was quite hard. Thus, Su Yu wasn’t doing that. Rather, Su Yu was attacking right in front of them.
Unsurprisingly, four Invincibles appeared in Su Yu’s path. Among them, there were one divine, two immortals, and one devil. One of them was Immortal King Tian Yu, a high-degree Eternal.
Immortal King Tian Yu coldly asked, “Guardian Grandstar, will the guardians fight for no reason? Think carefully. Don’t do something you’ll regret.”

Su Yu roared furiously, “Try touching me! I dare you! I am the head of all thirty-six holy cities! Touching me is the same as provoking the holy cities! Do you think you’re so strong? Do you want all thirty-six guardians to make a move and kill you all? Do you want your races to be eradicated?”
Tian Yu chucked, “Boy, you are too tender compared to Su Yu. At the very least, Su Yu isn’t stupid enough to say such childish words.”

He laughed with amusement. The three Invincibles beside him were laughing as well. All thirty-six guardians? How were they supposed to make a move? Were they going to ignore the laws and rush out of their cities?

Was that it? Were they going to abandon their posts only to be killed by the tribulation? The Invincibles laughed with amusement. This guy was quite calm before this, but his calm was fading fast at the first sign of trouble.

In this aspect, he was incomparable to the real Su Yu. Sure enough, a fake would be a fake. Not even a good disguise could hide his weak temperament. Then again, this was understandable. Not everyone could be Su Yu.
They did not even put much thought into it. They were already certain that they were facing a fake Su Yu. A real Su Yu should remain calm, not nervous.

Su Yu furiously said, “You are looking for me. And I’m here! You want to kill me! I’m here! Why are you not doing anything? Why are you wasting your time saying so much nonsense? I will shoulder the aftermath of what I did alone! Why implicate the others for what I did?”

A distant Invincible said, “Stop wasting time on an unrelated individual. Tian Yu, take care of Guardian Grandstar. Guardian Grandstar, I hope you won’t do anything rash. Leaving your city and killing for no reason is not in line with your responsibility. Must you make things awkward for all of us?”
They couldn’t be bothered to spare the fake Su Yu much attention. It would be a complete waste of time.

They understood that the fake Su Yu was merely trying to distract them or even lure them into attacking Grandstar and triggering a battle with the ancient cities. That would give the real Su Yu the chance to sneak back into the city.
Dream on.
Why should they fight someone like Grandstar for a nobody like that?
How laughable.
The four Invincibles only focused on surrounding Grandstar instead of initiating a fight.
Around the Luminous Domain Mansion, numerous people noticed the ruckus Su Yu was causing.
Those who had encountered Su Yu in the mansion remained indifferent as they knew that this was the fake Su Yu. After all, they had seen the real Su Yu in the mansion.

The enforcer elder from the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion said, “The Heavenly Hunt Pavilion is only in charge of information dissemination. I will narrate what I saw. I encountered Su Yu on the eighth level. He killed a friend from the Allheaven Treasure House. Next, he killed the heavily injured Blood Fire Devil King in the Bloodmount General’s Residence. I guarantee I’m telling what I saw.”
Nobody said anything. With a slight frown, the scholar asked, “Where is the Heaven Department head?”
“This…subordinate doesn’t know.”
At this point, even the pavilion Invincibles had revealed themselves. All of them looked doubtful. Where? Where was the Heaven Department head?
Dead? That shouldn’t be the case. The death of someone like that would create a phenomenon. Could it be that he was somehow left behind in the mansion?
Also…
Someone else asked impatiently, “Who has the nine-leaf skylotus?”
That was the most important question. Who had the nine-leaf skylotus?
“Su Yu!”
Hollow answered, “Su Yu has it!”
“Yes. Su Yu got it.”
That was the five elemental Invincible.
They were merely following what Su Yu suggested. Great Qin King’s expression changed slightly. Just then, the fate Invincible spoke up as well, “Su Yu took it.”
“It’s on Su Yu.”
September, who was busy chewing on something, said lazily, “Su Yu snatched it.”

Everyone had the same answer. Su Yu had snatched the skylotus. A realization hit Great Qin King. He had advised these people on what to say previously, but none had followed his suggestion. Clearly, they were still following Su Yu’s suggestion.
His heart thumped.
Su Yu was in big trouble.

Everyone was saying that Su Yu had the ultimate treasure. He was also the culprit for all the deaths. What else could he say? Was there a way out of this for Su Yu? Great Qin King looked at the distant Su Yu. Was that the real Su Yu?

Since the distance between them was too big, he couldn’t extend his willpower to check lest he wanted to provoke the other Invincibles. He could only check with his eyes, but he couldn’t determine anything.

If not even Great Qin King could be sure that this was the real Su Yu, it was only natural for everyone else to not have the answer as well. Among those who had survived the mansion, some were certain that Su Yu was among them, while some were wondering if Su Yu had left through the death tunnel, such as September and a few others.

They were quite suspicious of that, but none of them said anything. Saying that would make it harder for them to explain themselves. Why had they survived when so many Invincibles had died? That question alone was enough to stump them.
Thus, Su Yu’s suggestion was the best solution: pushing all the blame on him.
He alone would shoulder all the blame. That was his own decision. There was no need to complicate things when such an easy solution was present.
Meanwhile, the expressions of Great Xia King and the others changed repeatedly.

Su Yu. Again and again. He had taken the blame for everything. Even the nine-leaf skylotus was in his hands. Quite a lot of people were targeting that thing, especially those above the seventh-degree Eternal Realm. Nobody would reject such a treasure.
“Su Yu…got the nine-leaf skylotus as well?”
Everyone was left speechless. Were the people in the mansion trash? How did that happen?
“What’s his strength?”
“Strong enough to fight Pseudo Invincibles,” answered someone.

Once again, the Invincibles were rendered speechless. Were these people really so useless? Yes, someone capable of fighting Pseudo Invincibles was quite scary. But there were about thirty Invincibles and a large number of super Pseudo Invincibles capable of fighting Invincibles in the mansion. How did all of them lose the skylotus to Su Yu? Was this a joke?
